name: Rocket Bites - 200mg Edible Gummies - Strawberry Supernova
description:
Big flavor in a small bite. Rocket Bites Strawberry Supernova gummies deliver ripe, juicy strawberry taste — sweet, bright, and bursting with flavor in every piece.

Made with a hybrid profile for a balanced, easygoing feel, these fit comfortably any time of day. Each pack contains 10 gummies at 20mg each — 200mg total — so it's easy to dial in exactly the dose you want.

10 gummies × 20mg — 200mg per pack
Sweet Strawberry Supernova flavor — ripe, juicy strawberry
Hybrid — balanced and easygoing, great any time of day
Easy to portion — consistent dosing in every piece

Start low, go slow, and enjoy the ride.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
